description: Keyword search across the sections of the Indian Acts in this dataset — titles, keywords, the library’s section text and plain-English explanations — and across every enacted section heading of the BNS and BNSS. Returns the closest-matching sections with a one-line summary and a link. Use when the user describes a topic but does not know the Act or section number.

act.description: Limit the search to one Act: constitution = Constitution; bns = BNS 2023; bnss = BNSS 2023; ipc = IPC 1860; crpc = CrPC 1973; sarfaesi = SARFAESI Act 2002; ni-act = NI Act 1881; contract-act = Contract Act 1872; companies-act = Companies Act 2013; ibc = IBC 2016; cpc = CPC 1908; consumer-protection = CPA 2019; rera = RERA 2016; tpa = TPA 1882; arbitration-act = Arbitration Act 1996; bsa = BSA 2023; it-act = IT Act 2000; rti-act = RTI Act 2005; limitation-act = Limitation Act 1963; specific-relief = Specific Relief Act 1963

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "anticipatory bail", "cheque dishonour notice", "possession of secured asset", "section 17 SARFAESI"

name: search_bare_acts
title: Search bare acts
